2m EME 用 144MHz，是最热门的 EME 波段。: 2 m EME uses 144 MHz and is the most popular EME band.
Earth-Moon-Earth，利用月球反射电波，实现地球任意两地通联。: Earth–Moon–Earth: using the Moon to reflect radio waves, allowing contacts between any two points on Earth.
多个八木组成阵列或大型抛物面。: Several Yagis in an array, or a large parabolic dish.
往返约 250dB+，是业余通信中最苛刻的传播方式。: About 250 dB or more round trip — the most demanding propagation mode in amateur communication.
按月球位置与多普勒计算最佳通联窗口。: The best contact window is computed from the Moon's position and the Doppler shift.
月面各点到地球的径向速度不同，使回波频率展宽并产生约 0.1～数 Hz 的快速衰: Different points on the lunar surface have different radial velocities towards Earth, broadening the echo spectrum and producing rapid fading of about 0.1 to several hertz.
现代 EME 以 Q65 为主的弱信号数字模式，小台站也能参与；JT65 已被淘: Modern EME uses weak-signal digital modes, chiefly Q65, so even small stations can take part; JT65 is obsolete, has been removed from current WSJT-X versions and is incompatible with Q65.
现以 Q65 为主（JT65 已淘汰，两者是互不兼容的两种协议），大幅降低对功率: Q65 is now the main mode (JT65 is obsolete; the two are mutually incompatible protocols), greatly reducing the demands on power and antennas.
精确对准月球并补偿多普勒频率漂移。: Point accurately at the Moon and compensate for the Doppler frequency drift.
线极化波穿过电离层时极化面旋转，EME 常用圆极化天线以规避其影响。: A linearly polarised wave has its polarisation plane rotated passing through the ionosphere, so EME commonly uses circularly polarised antennas to avoid the effect.
需大功率功放与低损耗馈线。: Requires a high-power amplifier and low-loss feedline.
